obligations.title: Notify Customer promptly if an instruction infringes data protection law or law requires other processing.
Ensure personnel are bound by confidentiality, trained, and given need-based access only.
Maintain technical and organisational security measures meeting Schedule 2, including tested business-continuity arrangements.
Notify Customer without undue delay of a Security Incident, provide incident details, contain, investigate, remediate and keep Customer informed.
Give Customer reasonable prior notice of any intended Subprocessor addition or replacement.
Promptly forward data subject requests to Customer and assist with responses and data protection assessments.
Provide information and third-party audit reports or certifications demonstrating compliance.
Return or securely delete Customer Personal Data, including Subprocessor copies, on expiry, termination or request.
Certify deletion of Customer Personal Data in writing on request.
Identify approved Subprocessors in writing to Customer before the Effective Date.
